speaker: will_kemp
text: Jig, then. My lord left it. Cittern. Boys on the burden. One verse, and no invention past the verse.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Under the note, Nick. Glad is not a pitch.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am glad, though. I have the verse.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I stopped. I bowed. I did not know what else to do with a note that had left me.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: The next verse was already mine. I took it on the beat.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The cittern did not stop. A fifth is not a reason to stop a burden.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Three nights, and the best laugh of the three was not mine.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I came in on the note, Master Phillips. I forgot to come in under it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You were happy, and the tune took you. Do not clear your throat against it. Let it sit where it dropped.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: It's gone, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's come, Nick. Sly shall teach thee to fence.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: That verse was mine, then. I had it. I did not look at him while I took it. Looking would have made it a rescue, and it was the next verse.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No second try. The verse went to Arthur. You will not sing the broken one again tonight to see whether it is still a boy's.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No more songs this year, Nick. Not in the boat tomorrow, and not to find out whether the top is still there.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not try it again. I can walk without it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The hall laughed, and kindly. So did the chair.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The bow was the thing I would keep. Sly can have the teaching. I teach a body, and a body is the wrong instrument for this.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The bow was exact. A fifth lower, if a name is wanted for what came back. I am not asking him to sing the interval for proof.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A fifth lower, and then he stopped. I am not writing the music. It does not go on a paper tonight.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A laugh is not a receipt. Kindly is not a warrant, and it is not the three nights.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I heard it. I am not asking anyone to write it down.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: The burden is done. I am not starting another verse because an end feels thin.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sly, when there is a sword and a morning. Not me, and not tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Come away. Sly shall teach thee, Nick, when there is time. Not on this cloth.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: No song in the boat. I have said it. I will keep it.
